{"code": "import statsmodels.api as sm

# Create contingency table
table = pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['responded'])
print(table)

# Chi-squared test of independence
chi2, p_value, dof, expected = sm.stats.Table(table).test_nominal_association()
print(f"Chi-squared test p-value: {p_value}")

# Check for balance on key covariates: age, sex, severity, site, assay_batch
balance_check = {}
for col in ['age', 'sex', 'severity', 'site', 'assay_batch']:
    if df[col].dtype == 'object':
        # Categorical: use chi-squared
        tab = pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df[col])
        chi2, p, dof, expected = sm.stats.Table(tab).test_nominal_association()
        balance_check[col] = p
    else:
        # Continuous: use t-test
        t_stat, p_val = sm.stats.ttest_ind(
            df[df['arm'] == 'treatment'][col],
            df[df['arm'] == 'control'][col],
            usevar='pooled'
        )
        balance_check[col] = p_val

balance_check"}
